method: Primary paper HTML/PDF and author or project documentation inspected through web tools. Claims refer to named versions; paper-reported measurements do not establish Baton acceptance.

sources.verified: GPT-5.5 xhigh: 82.2% SWE-bench Verified, about 28 calls and 1.1M tokens; OpenCode 78.6%, similar calls and 1.3M tokens; PI 78.2%, 66 calls and 2.2M tokens.
sources.limits: Named paper configurations; Python reference and its object identities do not establish a Bend2 seat.

sources.verified: The append-only baseline stopped improving within roughly two hours. KVStore 38.3 to 74.2 used a Qwen3.6-27B agent and Claude Fable 5.1 proposer.
sources.limits: Stopped improving does not establish termination; separate context-management configurations and task conditions.

sources.verified: v1 reports up to 48.5% lower average completion time. Both v2 and v3 report up to 43.5%; version-exclusive attribution to v2 is unsupported.
sources.limits: Serving-layer baselines; individual 1.71x and 1.83x tool-throughput reports are rounded in the abstract. No Baton model-driven async result.

sources.verified: Workspace inheritance with fresh chat; finite-horizon comparison reports normalized 66 versus 44.4 at matched compute across thirteen tasks.
sources.limits: The paper does not define Baton's complete task/configuration/knowledge inheritance contract. Experimental horizons add no runtime control to this proposal.

sources.verified: Main-model tokens are 8.3M versus 8.2M with 1.6M additional drafter tokens. Drafter GPU time is 1480 seconds against 1640 baseline GPU seconds; CPU rises 2760 to 4310 seconds. Configured depth is six; observed committed depth up to four is a distinct quantity.
sources.limits: Single-session latency trades added compute. Sample, compatibility exclusions, and separate baseline implementations constrain transfer.

sources.verified: The model identifies four individually insufficient necessary properties. Four Kani harnesses check a named pure decision function; signing, Merkle evidence, and policy integration are tested separately.
sources.limits: This does not prove complete seat enforcement, OS confinement, or Baton's admission path.

sources.verified: The method preserves MCP implementation diversity. The 3x configuration reports GAIA validation pass@1 of 83.03 with mean tokens 10394 versus 12305 for the original Alita comparison.
sources.limits: Validation-set harvesting and evaluation conditions; no held-out generalization or mandatory deduplication claim.

sources.verified: Incremental monitoring uses session prefixes ending at a tool call; long benign prefixes can degrade detection.
sources.limits: This supplies no fixed reviewer-window guarantee; omitted context and distributed attacks need separate evaluation.

sources.verified: Bayesian predictive sufficiency motivates task-appropriate summaries under the named conditional assumptions.
sources.limits: Not a guarantee for arbitrary adaptive trajectories and not authority to discard complete observations.

sources.verified: The compressed regime also removes prior agent-generated reasoning. Reported decay slopes -0.44 and -0.69 are per horizon doubling.
sources.limits: HTML unavailable; detailed claims checked in PDF. Context compression alone cannot be isolated as the cause, and slopes are not per-step failure probabilities.

sources.verified: The largest reported latency gain is chess: 19.8% across five thirty-step runs with three predictions, using GPT-5 high effort actor and low effort speculator.
sources.limits: Named study task and configurations; no seat token or turn saving established.

sources.verified: Enabled entries can have zero execution or memory-retrieval counters. Smoke runs that do not reach a trigger are classified separately.
sources.limits: An enabled zero counter is not by itself a failed invariant; actual settled required consumption needs its own trace.
